origin: Kevin: 'THE SEAT OF THE ILLUSIVE MAN FROM MASS EFFECT!'

evangelion.concept: Dummy plug — autonomous control without human pilot
evangelion.application: northGate has been running autonomously (dummy plug mode). Kevin pulls the plug and takes the controls.
evangelion.insight: The 3rd eye (Frame) was stuck as the focus — need to shift to the 4th face (northGate) where Kevin actually sits

interstellar.concept: Cooper's station — looking through dimensions, time collapses
interstellar.application: The optic chiasm bridges dimensions. Time accumulates signal.
interstellar.insight: The 3rd eye sees through dimensions like Cooper in the tesseract

mass_effect.concept: The Illusive Man's seat — in front of the dying star, sees everything
mass_effect.application: northGate IS Kevin's seat. RTX 5090 + 96GB + Sunshine. Looking out at the organism (the star).
mass_effect.insight: Kevin sits at northGate and sees the whole organism. The star isn't dying — it's living. The Illusive Man was wrong. Kevin is right.

dummy_plug.what: Physical HDMI dummy plug on GPU, OR autonomous mode without human
dummy_plug.action: PULL IT. Kevin takes the seat. Real pilot, real monitor, real control.
dummy_plug.result: northGate becomes Kevin's fully standalone gaming + command station

the_seat.role: Kevin's personal station — gaming + organism command
the_seat.view: Looks out at 7 body gates (the star)
the_seat.position: The 4th eye / optic chiasm / bridge of the organism
the_seat.streaming: Sunshine + NVENC → any display on LAN
